items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: I work with Earl Foster years and years.

ctx.x: I hear quite a few fellas say they came from across the lake there, too.
That's right, from Mandeville, and I work with them often and times after time, but I can't remember. I work with Earl Foster. I work with Earl Foster years and years.
Yes, Andy Anderson was raised over there, too.
